Writing pick() is four lines. Typing it well is the difference.

pick(user, ['name']) returns Pick<T, K> and not the whole { name: string } shape.

Reserved: ( ) [ ] { } < > @ # * _ ~ | \ and an already-escaped \( pair.

Unicode bold, serif: 𝐩𝐢𝐜𝐤 and sans: 𝗽𝗶𝗰𝗸 — neither is reserved.

Emoji pass through untouched: 🚀 💡 😉

A tracking link: https://example.com/x?a=(b)&c=[d]&e={f}

#shenbabuilds @someone a_b_c ~tilde~ *star* |pipe|
Mixed newlines matter: this paragraph is separated by CRLF,
and this line too, while everything above uses LF.
